answer: Let every reward claim carry stamps from a rotating quorum of independent verifiers, each re-checking a random slice of the claimant's work before stamping. A voyage through the network then leaves a trail of third-party checks, not self-asserted history. A farm must fool a fresh quorum every epoch, and verifiers earn only when their verdicts match consensus, so a bribed stamp is an ember that burns its issuer's own income. One honest verifier in the sable-dark quorum is enough to block a fake claim, and scale only multiplies the independent eyes a farm must deceive.
